reasons: The cited § 6 language grants the MFN to Client (TrueLink's rates for Hosting Services 'will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party'), i.e., parity runs in our favour, which matches the rule's preferred position of no MFN obligation on Customer.

No Customer-side obligation to extend TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers appears in the supplied text, supporting the 'compliant' classification.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the rendered redline is byte-identical to the original paragraph and no counterparty comment was proposed — correct handling per the detection guidance ('If the Vendor grants Customer best pricing, mark compliant and do not redline').
No deterministic check failures; rationale is accurate and appropriately retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
